subject.title: [Feature]: Discord: Re-process edited user messages (MESSAGE_UPDATE event)

question: Should Discord edited-message reprocessing land as opt-in config, default-on plugin behavior, or only as part of the broader edit/delete lifecycle in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92091?
rationale: The missing source path is clear, but config/default behavior and whether to bundle delete-to-cancel with this edit-only request are product and upgrade-semantics choices that source inspection cannot decide.

options.title: Settle semantics in the linked PR
options.body: Use the active PR or a narrow replacement as the decision point, requiring live Discord proof and explicit default/config behavior before merge.

options.title: Require opt-in edit config
options.body: Implement handleEdits and edit debounce as disabled-by-default Discord config, matching this issue's compatibility proposal while accepting new config surface.

options.title: Split delete-to-cancel
options.body: Land edit-to-reprocess separately and keep delete-to-cancel on the broader lifecycle tracker if cancellation semantics are not ready.

recommendation.title: Settle semantics in the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the active PR or a narrow replacement as the decision point, requiring live Discord proof and explicit default/config behavior before merge.
